async def act(page):
    # Fill in the title for the issue
    title_textbox = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Title", exact=True)
    await title_textbox.fill('OSError: [Errno 98] Address already in use during executions')
    # Fill in the description for the issue
    description_textbox = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Description", exact=True)
    await description_textbox.fill('I am experiencing an OSError: [Errno 98] Address already in use during executions in the aem-hacker project.')
    # Click the submit button to create the issue
    submit_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Submit issue", exact=True)
    await submit_button.click()
    # Wait for navigation after submission
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
